messages:
Maya Chen: opened a PR to clean up the localization matrix and add ap-sg region entries. spotted ambiguous wording in the Private deployment data residency note. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/842

Leo Park: saw it, thanks. i updated the SDK snippet to use the region header but left a todo about legacy endpoint guidance. which header should we document as primary: `X-Redwood-Region` or `Redwood-Region`?

Samir Patel: we agreed on `X-Redwood-Region` for server SDKs last quarter; older client docs used `Redwood-Region`. recommend documenting both, and encourage `X-Redwood-Region` for new integrations.

Maya Chen: agreed. add a short migration note explaining why to switch (load-balancer/proxy compatibility). keep it one sentence.

Leo Park: added a concise migration section in the PR. @Natalie Gomez can you add tiny examples (curl + node) and check a broken GDPR footnote anchor?

Natalie Gomez: on it. drafting two micro-examples and fixing the anchor. snippets: 
```bash
# curl
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Region: ap-sg-1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

```js
// node (fetch)
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`, 'X-Redwood-Region': 'ap-sg-1', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'hello' }) })
```

Natalie Gomez: also updated the matrix CSV row for ap-sg-1 and added the footnote redirect for GDPR anchor. preview looks fine on mobile.

Maya Chen: QA checklist — (1) confirm header text and examples render on mobile/desktop, (2) update CSV row, (3) validate GDPR footnote anchor redirect, (4) tighten Private deployment residency blurb.

Samir Patel: i'll update the CSV and the redirect. noted a small nit on KMS/HSM mention in the residency blurb; left comment. :white_check_mark:

Leo Park: formatting nit fixed in the snippet. suggested shortening the migration sentence to: "If you previously set `Redwood-Region`, migrate to `X-Redwood-Region` to avoid routing issues."

Natalie Gomez: pushed that phrasing and the example commit. docs-bot: deploy-preview for PR #842 published: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/842 — please review. :eyes: 

Maya Chen: CI passed, merging in 5. will follow up to add an internal onboarding cross-ref and a short release note for docs. thanks all! :rocket:
